clips.title: The story
paras: An Alliance warlock crosses the sea to seek Takar the Seer’s counsel on summoning a succubus. Gakin the Darkbinder sends Stormwind initiates into the Barrens for the wisdom they need.

Beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter, Gakin the Darkbinder guides promising warlocks toward summoning a succubus. The demon devours souls, destroys hearts, and dominates minds, so it cannot be called blindly into Azeroth. A warlock needs a potent lure: an object tied to pure love. That token draws the succubus from the Twisting Nether, where the warlock can defeat and bind it. Stormwind’s covens cannot teach them where to find such an object.

Gakin sends his pupils across the Great Sea to Kalimdor in search of the needed catalyst. Takar the Seer waits in the arid Barrens, near the Horde settlement of Camp Taurajo. To reach him, an Alliance warlock must cross wilderness patrolled by hostile centaur, quilboar, and Horde warriors. The journey tests whether a summoner can survive before the ritual even begins.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A succubus is a devourer of souls, destroyer of hearts, and dominator of minds. It knows nothing but evil.
This will be the creature you will learn to summon and control, but it cannot be brought into our world without a stimulus.
With a symbol of love as bait, it will surely answer your call. Then you can defeat it, and make it your tool.
It will be hard to find something of this nature, though. You should speak with Takar the Seer. You will find him in the Barrens of Kalimdor near Camp Taurajo.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Was your crossing difficult, friend? You have come a long way to speak with me. But fear not, I know why Gakin has sent you, and he was wise to, for I can help you in your search.
